args.title: AC-1 Overview lists the products in the cart with their prices
args.steps:
1. Sign in as standard_user with password secret_sauce|Login succeeds and Products page is shown
2. Click the first Add to cart button in the product list|Cart badge shows "1"
3. Click the cart icon|Your Cart page is displayed
4. Click Checkout|Checkout: Your Information page is displayed
5. Fill in First Name "Jane", Last Name "Doe", Postal Code "12345" and click Continue|Checkout: Overview page is displayed
6. Observe the product listed on the overview page|The product name is visible
7. Observe the product price listed on the overview page|The product price is visible

args.title: AC-2 Item total equals the sum of the listed prices
args.steps:
1. Sign in as standard_user with password secret_sauce|Login succeeds and Products page is shown
2. Click the first Add to cart button in the product list|Cart badge shows "1"
3. Click the cart icon|Your Cart page is displayed
4. Click Checkout|Checkout: Your Information page is displayed
5. Fill in First Name "Jane", Last Name "Doe", Postal Code "12345" and click Continue|Checkout: Overview page is displayed
6. Read the price(s) listed for each item in the overview|Individual item prices are visible
7. Read the Item total label on the overview page|Item total is displayed (e.g. "Item total: $X.XX")
8. Verify that the item total equals the sum of all listed item prices|The item total matches the arithmetic sum of the individual prices shown

args.title: AC-3 Total equals the item total plus the tax shown
args.steps:
1. Sign in as standard_user with password secret_sauce|Login succeeds and Products page is shown
2. Click the first Add to cart button in the product list|Cart badge shows "1"
3. Click the cart icon|Your Cart page is displayed
4. Click Checkout|Checkout: Your Information page is displayed
5. Fill in First Name "Jane", Last Name "Doe", Postal Code "12345" and click Continue|Checkout: Overview page is displayed
6. Read the Item total label|Item total is displayed (e.g. "Item total: $X.XX")
7. Read the Tax label|Tax is displayed as its own line (e.g. "Tax: $X.XX")
8. Read the Total label|Total is displayed (e.g. "Total: $X.XX")
9. Verify that the Total equals the Item total plus the Tax|Total = Item total + Tax (testing the tax rate itself is out of scope)
